Function ReadP(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
ReadP="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
ReadP="Empty(0)"
ElseIf IsError(v) Then
ReadP="CVErr(10)"
Else
ReadP=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
ReadP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function PutP(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
PutP="ok:" & ReadP(o,k)
Exit Function
Failed:
PutP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function ConfigurationState() As String
Dim p As Object,k As Variant,s As String,n As Name
On Error GoTo Failed
Set p=ActiveSheet.PageSetup
s="sheet=" & ActiveSheet.Name
For Each k In Array("LeftMargin","RightMargin","TopMargin","BottomMargin","HeaderMargin","FooterMargin","Orientation","PaperSize","Order","FirstPageNumber","BlackAndWhite","Draft","PrintComments","PrintErrors","Zoom","FitToPagesWide","FitToPagesTall","CenterHorizontally","CenterVertically","PrintGridlines","PrintHeadings","PrintArea","PrintTitleRows","PrintTitleColumns")
s=s & ";" & k & "=" & ReadP(p,CStr(k))
Next k
s=s & ";names=["
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & n.Visible & "|"
Next n
ConfigurationState=s & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
ConfigurationState=s & ";STATE-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function AlterPage() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveSheet.PageSetup.LeftMargin=18
AlterPage="changed"
Exit Function
Failed:
AlterPage="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function DirectMargin(p As PageSetup,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
p.LeftMargin=v
DirectMargin="ok:" & ReadP(p,"LeftMargin")
Exit Function
Failed:
DirectMargin="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function TryMargin() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveSheet.PageSetup.LeftMargin=18
TryMargin="changed"
Exit Function
Failed:
TryMargin="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function TryOrientation() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveSheet.PageSetup.Orientation=xlLandscape
TryOrientation="changed"
Exit Function
Failed:
TryOrientation="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function TryPrintArea() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveSheet.PageSetup.PrintArea="A1:B9"
TryPrintArea="changed"
Exit Function
Failed:
TryPrintArea="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function DeleteQuiet(w As Worksheet) As String
Dim oldAlerts As Boolean,n As Long,d As String
oldAlerts=Application.DisplayAlerts
On Error GoTo Failed
Application.DisplayAlerts=False
w.Delete
Application.DisplayAlerts=oldAlerts
DeleteQuiet="ok"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
d=Err.Description
Application.DisplayAlerts=oldAlerts
DeleteQuiet="ERR:" & n & ":" & d
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim owner As Worksheet,other As Worksheet,survivor As Worksheet,s As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set owner=ActiveSheet
owner.Name="Original"
Set other=Worksheets.Add(After:=owner)
other.Name="Other"
owner.Activate
owner.PageSetup.PrintArea="A1:B9,D2:E4"
owner.PageSetup.PrintTitleRows="2:3"
owner.PageSetup.PrintTitleColumns="B:C"
s="created=[" & ConfigurationState() & "]"
owner.Name="O'Brien Data"
s=s & ";renamed=[" & ConfigurationState() & "]"
owner.Move After:=other
owner.Activate
s=s & ";moved-after=[" & ConfigurationState() & "]"
owner.Move Before:=other
owner.Activate
s=s & ";moved-before=[" & ConfigurationState() & "]"
Probe=s & ";final=[" & ConfigurationState() & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=s & ";PROBE-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function

Function ReadP(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
ReadP="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
ReadP="Empty(0)"
ElseIf IsError(v) Then
ReadP="CVErr(10)"
Else
ReadP=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
ReadP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function PutP(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
PutP="ok:" & ReadP(o,k)
Exit Function
Failed:
PutP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function ConfigurationState() As String
Dim p As Object,k As Variant,s As String,n As Name
On Error GoTo Failed
Set p=ActiveSheet.PageSetup
s="sheet=" & ActiveSheet.Name
For Each k In Array("LeftMargin","RightMargin","TopMargin","BottomMargin","HeaderMargin","FooterMargin","Orientation","PaperSize","Order","FirstPageNumber","BlackAndWhite","Draft","PrintComments","PrintErrors","Zoom","FitToPagesWide","FitToPagesTall","CenterHorizontally","CenterVertically","PrintGridlines","PrintHeadings","PrintArea","PrintTitleRows","PrintTitleColumns")
s=s & ";" & k & "=" & ReadP(p,CStr(k))
Next k
s=s & ";names=["
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & n.Visible & "|"
Next n
ConfigurationState=s & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
ConfigurationState=s & ";STATE-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function AlterPage() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveSheet.PageSetup.LeftMargin=18
AlterPage="changed"
Exit Function
Failed:
AlterPage="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function DirectMargin(p As PageSetup,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
p.LeftMargin=v
DirectMargin="ok:" & ReadP(p,"LeftMargin")
Exit Function
Failed:
DirectMargin="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function TryMargin() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveSheet.PageSetup.LeftMargin=18
TryMargin="changed"
Exit Function
Failed:
TryMargin="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function TryOrientation() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveSheet.PageSetup.Orientation=xlLandscape
TryOrientation="changed"
Exit Function
Failed:
TryOrientation="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function TryPrintArea() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveSheet.PageSetup.PrintArea="A1:B9"
TryPrintArea="changed"
Exit Function
Failed:
TryPrintArea="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function DeleteQuiet(w As Worksheet) As String
Dim oldAlerts As Boolean,n As Long,d As String
oldAlerts=Application.DisplayAlerts
On Error GoTo Failed
Application.DisplayAlerts=False
w.Delete
Application.DisplayAlerts=oldAlerts
DeleteQuiet="ok"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
d=Err.Description
Application.DisplayAlerts=oldAlerts
DeleteQuiet="ERR:" & n & ":" & d
End Function
